_doc: Every place the plugin touches Elden Ring. source = where the method comes from. verified=true only after it ran in the player's game (exe 2.7.1.0). Field note = universal-modder knowledge/games/elden-ring/cs2-conversion...md (2026-10-03, exe 2.7.1.0).

rows.how: Bundled ModEngine2 2.1.0 (MIT) in {managed}/me2, launched by the recipe with -c our config_eldenring.toml and -p {game}/Game/eldenring.exe. (0.0.1 lesson: Melty's shared ModEngine2 in Melty/mods/loaders/modengine2 reads only its own config with external_dlls=[]; files mapped to {managed}/modengine2 are never read.)
rows.source: user's ModEngine2 log 2026-10-06 + ModEngine2 launcher.cpp (-c/-p options)

rows.how: wait for visible game window, then a fresh fromsoftware-rs reflection scan; never touch singletons from DllMain [window gate verified 2026-10-06: visible after 0.3 s; reflection-scan part not yet]
hook DirectInput GetDeviceState; read our keys, blank them for the game [polling via GetAsyncKeyState verified 2026-10-06 for all 6 keys; DirectInput blanking not yet]
write CSChrPhysicsModule position + chr_proxy_pos_update_requested after physics; Havok ray casts (CSPhysWorld::cast_ray, filter 0x2000058); hand back control for ladders/mount/death
while our controller drives: gravity_multiplier=0, gravity_disabled=true; restore after; apply own landing damage
CSBulletManager::spawn_bullet with our own Bullet/Atk rows appended to the player's regulation.bin (life >= 2 frames)
plugin writes its own log next to the DLL (the test oracle)
